Uniform covariance has trace k and squared trace k(k+1)/F, hence exact normalized formula; zero-defect implies the dual complete graph and simplex boundary. value.rationale: The same-F homology polytopes are unimodularly equivalent to the cycle symmetric edge polytope by existing work, but their canonical Euclidean congruence classes are exactly distinct dual graphs. This resolves the natural metric-classification question completely; the independent universal covariance formula quantifies nonisotropy solely from (d,F) and rigidly characterizes simplex boundaries. The two published F=14 triangulations demonstrate noncongruence despite equal covariance-defect scalar.
